$comment: Mode definitions. Data only. "implemented" modes have working intents; "planned" modes are defined but cannot be entered.

modes.name: War
modes.summary: Organized conflict between factions. Not part of the PEACETIME release.

modes.name: Hunt
modes.summary: Track, locate, pursue, observe, capture, recover or defeat a target, as the Realm and server rules allow. Targets may be Familiars, animals, lost objects, fugitives, rare resources, historical artifacts or NPC threats. Hunting does not inherently require killing.

modes.name: Search
modes.summary: Look for hidden things: lost items, clues, forgotten places.

modes.name: Heist
modes.summary: Planned capers against guarded targets. Requires a server that allows player crime.

modes.name: Empire
modes.summary: Long-horizon stewardship of holdings, organizations and territory.

modes.name: Drive
modes.summary: Vehicle, mount, transport and movement-centred play: racing, travel, delivery, convoys, navigation, vehicle and mount ownership, route mastery and transport businesses. Its expression depends on the Realm.

realmExpressions.realm_happy-fall: horses, carriages, wagons, boats and other mounts
realmExpressions.later-realms: may include automobiles, aircraft or spacecraft where the Realm's technology allows

modes.name: Live
modes.summary: Everyday life in a Realm: move, talk, trade, work and keep a home.

modes.name: Veil
modes.summary: Mystery, uncertainty and hidden information: rumors, omens, hidden history, investigation, uncertain threats, strange Familiars, folklore, curses as cultural claims and psychological horror. Veil does not make supernatural claims Canonically true.
modes.canonNote: Cultural interpretation (rumor, omen, curse, folklore) is kept separate from verified Canonical evidence. A Veil story never creates Canonical facts.

modes.name: Forge
modes.summary: Make things: crafting now, world and content creation later.

modes.name: Tournament
modes.summary: Structured competitions with brackets and rules.

modes.name: Spectate
modes.summary: Watch events and other players without taking part.

modes.name: Companion
modes.summary: Time with your Familiars: care, bond and wander together.

modes.name: Explore
modes.summary: Follow roads and paths outward and discover new places.

modes.name: Invest
modes.summary: Put coin to work: ventures, shares and property.

modes.name: Scholar
modes.summary: Study, practice and teach. Foundation for the Learn domain.

modes.name: Social
modes.summary: Meet people, keep relationships and take part in community life.
